ios.desc:
Listen to more than 50,000 radio stations from every country, for free. No ads in the app, no account, no sign-up. Tap a station and it plays.

FIND YOUR STATION
• Browse by country or genre, or search by name
• Pop, rock, news, talk, sports, jazz, classical, electronic and much more
• Stations from your country first, the whole world one tap away

NEVER LOSE A SONG
• Song history keeps every track you heard, with the station and the time
• One tap opens the song in Apple Music or Spotify
• Album artwork in the player and on the Lock Screen

WAKE UP TO YOUR RADIO
• A real alarm that rings even when the app is closed and the iPhone is locked
• One tap on "Listen to radio" starts your station
• Sleep timer to fall asleep with the radio on

ALWAYS CLOSE
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets for your stations and what's playing
• Ask Siri to play a station, or use it in Shortcuts
• Playback controls on the Lock Screen and in Control Center, plus AirPlay
• Favorites and recently played stations, kept on your device

The radio alarm needs iOS 26.1 or later.

Stations come from Radio Browser, a free, community-maintained directory of internet radio. SonoNation does not own or operate the stations; the streams and their content belong to the broadcasters.

show_hn.title: Show HN: SonoNation – music discovery platform - Radio songs saved instantly

quotes.text:
Hi, HN!

I present to you Sononation - it is a music discovery platform.

We created Sononation to skip Shazam when listening to Radio. What the app does: you listen to your favorite Radio station and if the station is providing the info about the current artist and song you can save it to listen to it later, via Youtube.
You can also discover music tagged by the community members.

Discovery mode works worldwide. Radios are only from Europe for the moment but will add more and more countries.

Long description

Listen, Save, Enjoy, Discover is our motto.

Listen to your favorite radio and chat with its listeners.

Save current song that is played on the radio.

Enjoy your previously saved songs.

Discover new music, curated by the community.
